keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: Video generation
keywords.about: Video generators are made controllable, budget-routed, and faster through diffusion-transformer attention and planning.

keywords.name: World models
keywords.about: World models predict future states for video, embodied navigation, health trajectories, and planning.

keywords.name: Vision-language models
keywords.about: Vision-language models read radio fields, infer social dynamics, and expose tokenizer vulnerabilities.

keywords.name: KV cache
keywords.about: KV-cache compression and caching speed up long-context LLM, VLA, and video-generation inference.

keywords.name: Agent benchmarks
keywords.about: Agent benchmarks evaluate visual gameplay, physics analysis, money spending, and self-evolving harnesses.

keywords.name: 3D scene reconstruction
keywords.about: Methods reconstruct and understand 3D scenes from video, multi-view geometry, and Gaussian splatting.

keywords.name: Long-video understanding
keywords.about: Agents and memory structures retrieve evidence from ultra-long videos for question answering and reconstruction.

keywords.name: Diffusion and flow models
keywords.about: Diffusion and flow models are analyzed for fairness, adversarial tokenization, distribution learning, and controllable generation.

keywords.name: Computational pathology
keywords.about: Pathology models grade prostate cancer, detect fetal anomalies, and generate whole-slide reports under quality controls.

keywords.name: Multimodal LLMs
keywords.about: Multimodal LLMs are tested on smartphone inspection, recommendation, pathology reporting, and spatiotemporal planning.

keywords.name: Multimodal emotion recognition
keywords.about: Emotion recognition fuses audio, visual, and text signals while handling modality conflict and routing collapse.

keywords.name: Wearable sensing

themes.name: LLM agents and multi-agent orchestration
themes.summary: These papers design and study harnesses, coordination protocols, and oversight mechanisms for LLM agents, ranging from decentralized multi-agent architectures and debate-based orchestration to agentic coding and tool-use frameworks. They differ in focus: some build reusable agent harnesses with memory, skills, and context management, others benchmark agent behavior under tool failures, imperfect instructions, or serving conditions, and several apply agentic systems to domains such as data curation, science, medicine, and design search.

themes.name: Embodied vision-language-action and world models
themes.summary: The papers develop vision-language-action policies and learned world models for embodied robots, spanning efficient inference, robustness and safety, memory, and planning. Some focus on accelerating or calibrating VLA deployment and defending against attacks, while others build world models that predict future states or action outcomes to guide planning and evaluation. They differ in whether the contribution is a policy-side mechanism or a predictive world model, and in the robotic domain considered.

themes.name: Diffusion and Flow Matching Generative Models
themes.summary: The papers develop and analyze diffusion and flow-matching generative models, spanning guidance mechanisms, sampling dynamics, reward alignment, and efficient architectures. Some works provide theoretical accounts of score errors, parallel sampling, and transport maps, while others apply these models to clinical imaging, video, 3D interaction, segmentation, and astrophysical simulation. They differ in whether they target methodological advances, inference-time steering, or domain-specific synthesis.

themes.name: LLM safety privacy and adversarial robustness
themes.summary: These papers evaluate and defend large language models against safety failures, privacy leakage, and adversarial manipulation. They audit evaluation practices such as sycophancy measurement, harmfulness criteria, and safety taxonomies, while proposing defenses against backdoors, abliteration, covert channels, and visual privacy exposure. Others analyze adversarial attacks, agentic workflow risks, and robustness of code generation.

themes.name: Multimodal LLM Reasoning, Alignment, and Hallucination Verification
themes.summary: These papers probe how vision-language and multimodal models reason over images, video, and spatial scenes, and where that reasoning breaks down. Several expose verification and measurement failures—object hallucination, wrong-object boxes, symbol-to-state binding, and answer-evidence gaps—and propose calibrated, label-free or training-free verifiers and evidence gates. Others target alignment, cross-modal representation, and benchmarks for spatial planning, multi-view geometry, and domain drawing sets.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical language models
themes.summary: This cluster develops and evaluates medical vision-language and clinical language systems, spanning multilingual medical question answering, biomedical reasoning with process rewards, on-premises medical LLM post-training, and rule- or plan-guided radiology and pathology report generation. A complementary strand builds domain foundation models and examines robustness and data quality through adversarial tokenizer attacks, synthetic-data scorecards, leakage audits, quality-control policies, and controlled segmentation benchmarks. The work differs in whether it targets clinical text reasoning and report generation or image-centric representation, evaluation, and robustness.

themes.name: 3D Gaussian splatting and occupancy reconstruction
themes.summary: These papers advance explicit Gaussian and occupancy representations for reconstruction, combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with multi-objective optimization, sparse-view generalization, streaming caches, and watermarking. Occupancy-focused work improves view transformation, cooperative multi-agent fusion, and LiDAR planar-patch reconstruction. Other papers use video generation, diffusion, and sparse SDF/mesh serialization to make feed-forward 3D reconstruction, generation, and extrapolation more efficient.

themes.name: Efficient LLM Inference and KV Cache Compression
themes.summary: The papers target memory and latency bottlenecks in LLM serving, spanning KV cache compression, sparse attention, speculative decoding, weight quantization, and token pruning. Some contribute systems-level runtimes and GPU provisioning, while others propose algorithmic compression, pruning, and decoding schemes. They differ in whether they optimize cache access, weight storage, visual-token retention, or scheduling for throughput.

themes.name: Video generation and long-video understanding
themes.summary: The papers build and control generative video systems while also helping agents understand extremely long videos. Some improve generation through causal intervention, physical conditioning, editing, object insertion, and temporal guidance, whereas others organize long-video evidence into hierarchical, object-aware, or agent-searchable memory for question answering.

themes.name: Wearable and EEG Physiological Signal Modeling
themes.summary: The papers develop and evaluate models for physiological and movement signals captured by wearables and EEG, spanning wrist and inertial activity recognition, running-form and gait analysis, ECG arrhythmia detection, and PPG heart-rate estimation. They also probe EEG-specific modeling questions, including interpretable discharge and ADHD feature families, foundation-model pre-training, cross-modal generation and decoding, and privacy vulnerabilities. Approaches differ in emphasis on benchmark design and participant-held-out validation, interpretability and explainability, on-device efficiency, and multimodal or physics-informed representation learning.

themes.name: Multimodal Emotion Recognition and Social Understanding
themes.summary: These papers build multimodal emotion recognition systems that fuse facial, speech, physiological, and textual cues, addressing input reliability, cross-modal consensus and conflict, routing efficiency, and mixture-of-experts diversity. Others extend affective modeling toward group-level social dynamics, AI-twin social judgment, educational affective trajectories, and audio-visual facial expression analysis, differing in architectures such as hierarchical fusion, temporal heterogeneous graphs, and adaptive modality cascading.

themes.name: Causal inference and statistical guardrails for deployment
themes.summary: The papers develop statistical machinery for making deployment decisions defensible: power analysis for small A/B trials, risk-controlled adoption of model updates under few calibration images, cross-context threshold tests for discrimination auditing, and anytime-valid monitoring of deployed risk models. Others contribute targeted-learning and robust forest estimators for treatment effects from observational or externally controlled data, alongside a first-principles commentary on where AI methods succeed locally yet fail broader inferential assumptions and a Zero-Trust operational assurance framework for LLM systems under governance opacity.

highlights.title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
highlights.authors: Jian Xu, Delu Zeng, Qibin Zhao
highlights.why: This careful audit separates true agentic gains from simple rejection retry across recent text-to-image systems, reframing claimed improvements and providing closed-form budgets and a genuine agentic ceiling.
highlights.key_result: Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. We also show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5 less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy, and that on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval).

We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5 less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy.

The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval).

highlights.title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
highlights.authors: Yiyang Zhu, Xin Li, Guangyuan Liu et al.
highlights.theme: Multimodal LLM Reasoning, Alignment, and Hallucination Verification
highlights.why: Builds RadioVISTA with exact simulated radio fields and counterfactuals, revealing frontier VLMs can locate strong fields but fail to trace propagation paths.
highlights.key_result: Across 19 evaluated models, the top two identify the best-covered urban region in roughly nine out of ten cases. Yet when asked whether a single direct or one-wall path exists, their accuracy drops to 76.5% and 61.8% against a 50% random baseline.

We term this gap field--path dissociation, where models judge the whole without resolving its parts ( sec:eval,sec:readtrace).

highlights.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
highlights.authors: Mark Zhao, Pengcheng Wang, Rui Yang et al.
highlights.why: AutoPILOT harness lets visual game agents run macros and closed-loop controllers between model calls, achieving large real-time gains over VISTA and introducing AFK-Bench.
highlights.key_result: With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA , and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA 's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost.

highlights.title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
highlights.authors: Wenqi Marshall Guo, Kuan-Hao Huang, Junda Chen et al.
highlights.why: A minimal coding-agent harness with JSON per-minute records beats purpose-built memory graphs on ultra-long video QA, questioning complex memory designs.
highlights.key_result: On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video.

highlights.title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
highlights.authors: Kewei Lian, Jiayi Zhai, Anji Liu
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM Inference and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: Derives attention-error bounds that motivate query-adaptive KV clustering and achieves a new quality-latency Pareto frontier with up to 7.6x attention speedup.
highlights.key_result: Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6 speedup in the attention phase and 1.66 faster decoding, establishing a new quality–latency Pareto frontier.

highlights.title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
highlights.authors: Ulrik Unneberg, Shiyi Wang, Lee Cheuk-Kit et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion and Flow Matching Generative Models
highlights.why: Brings classifier-free guidance and a scalable training recipe to one-step Beckmann transport models, reaching strong ImageNet one-step FID without distillation.
highlights.key_result: Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation.

highlights.title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Gun Kaynar, Boshen Yan, Carl Kingsford
highlights.why: Introduces RetryRealistic, a controlled fault-injection testbed finding 6-26% silent fabrication and identifying partial-data faults as key drivers, with a verification-first monitor reducing fabrication.
highlights.key_result: Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19--68% correct) and frequently silent: 6--26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%.

highlights.title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM Inference and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: Treats the grammar as a second drafter in speculative decoding for structured outputs, boosting acceptance lengths with no new kernels and practical serving impact.
highlights.key_result: GaaD raises the average acceptance length (tokens per verify step, including the bonus token) from 2.06 to 5.43 for MTP on Qwen3.5-0.8B (1.99 to 5.31 on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), from 1.57 to 4.13 for DFlash and from 1.30 to 3.64 for n-gram on Qwen3-4B, and decodes 2.66--2.81 faster than the best configuration of each drafter alone at batch size 1 and 1.14--1.70 faster at batch size 64.

news.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
news.summary: OpenAI and Cisco announced Shirudo, an open-source eBPF-based runtime that lets operators deploy temporary "shields" to protect running Linux systems while patches are rolled out, with shields cryptographically signed and verified and recorded via a Trusted Platform Module. In a controlled test, a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit attempt against a running Elasticsearch service without a restart by adding an input check to Java's Base64 decoder.

news.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
news.summary: Richpanel reported completing approximately 300 AI customer-support deployments in the six months before an October 2026 interview, using GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol for its "Boss AI" setup agent and GPT-6 Luna for frontline conversations. The company guarantees a 50% automation rate within the first 30 days and said it met that commitment across all those deployments.

news.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
news.summary: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents to find improved quantum circuits, with each result proved in the Lean theorem prover, and is open-sourcing its Lean library, problem specifications, and verified solutions. Reported gains include an 11.8x cost reduction and memory lowered from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits for an inertial confinement fusion calculation, 8x cheaper simulation of a light-sensitive molecule, a 2.5x improvement for Cytochrome P450 with memory cut from 481 to 333 qubits, a 2.57x speedup for a Grover's algorithm implementation, and a 290x speedup for arcsin.

news.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
news.summary: Google Research presented DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that replaces fixed additive residual connections with learnable per-token routing weights and depth-wise cross-attention over previous layer embeddings, described in an ICML 2025 paper. The authors report models reaching the same quality up to three times faster with up to 30-40% fewer parameters and a negligible increase in parameters.

news.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
news.summary: Google added Google Wallet and Google Drive to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode, rolling out Wallet opt-in first with Drive and the Gemini app support following in the coming weeks; these join Gmail, Calendar, and Photos. Connected Wallet data is read-only for AI Mode, which the post says cannot move, manage, or invest money, and users can manage connections in Search Personalization settings.

news.title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season
news.summary: NVIDIA published a holiday gift guide covering GeForce RTX 50 Series laptops and desktops on the Blackwell architecture with fifth-generation Tensor Cores and fourth-generation RT Cores, RTX Spark PCs, DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, Reflex and G-SYNC, GeForce NOW with more than 4,500 titles, Studio Drivers, and the Jetson edge AI platform with the JetPack SDK for robot projects.

news.title: Accelerating Direct Sparse Solvers for Computational Engineering with NVIDIA cuDSS 1.0
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuDSS 1.0, a production-ready GPU-accelerated direct sparse solver for engineering and scientific simulations. It reports geometric-mean speedups over Intel MKL of 2.5x for analysis, 5.9x for numerical factorization, and 151x for triangular solve, GPU symbolic factorization 2.21x faster than cuDSS 0.8.0, hybrid memory mode cutting minimum device memory by about 30% on large VLSI cases, and default symmetry-preserving matching with HSL MC64 and Bunch-Kaufman pivoting improving normwise relative backward error by up to 10 orders of magnitude on SuiteSparse matrices.

news.title: Get Started with GPU-Accelerated DuckDB Analytics Using the Sirius Core Extension
news.summary: NVIDIA and DuckLabs released Sirius, an open-source GPU-native SQL engine as a DuckDB core extension, installed and loaded with the SQL commands INSTALL sirius and LOAD sirius, with unsupported features falling back to DuckDB's CPU engine. Benchmarks on TPC-H queries at scale factors up to 10 TB showed 3.25x to 5.50x speedups and up to 79% lower query-time compute cost with tuned two-GPU configurations; DuckDB 2.0 and a compatible NVIDIA GPU driver are required.

news.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
news.summary: Hugging Face released RoboTrack, a point-tracking benchmark and training data suite for robotic manipulation, comprising RoboTrack-Bench with 307 human-annotated videos from DROID, Ego-Exo4D, MolmoAct 2 and EgoVerse containing 2,522 point tracks, plus RoboTrack-15M synthetic data generated in MolmoSpaces. It also released two models, RoboTracker (fine-tuned AllTracker) and RoboTracker-Warp (trained from CoWTracker), with RoboTracker-Warp achieving state-of-the-art results on four of five evaluated benchmarks; leading trackers scored much lower on RoboTrack-Bench than on existing robotics benchmarks.

themes.summary: 这些论文构建并控制生成式视频系统，同时帮助智能体理解极长视频。有些通过因果干预、物理条件化、编辑、对象插入和时间引导改进生成，而另一些将长视频证据组织成分层、对象感知或智能体可搜索的记忆以用于问答。

themes.name: 可穿戴与 EEG 生理信号建模
themes.summary: 这些论文开发并评估可穿戴设备和 EEG 捕获的生理与运动信号模型，涵盖手腕和惯性活动识别、跑步姿态与步态分析、ECG 心律失常检测和 PPG 心率估计。它们还探究 EEG 特有的建模问题，包括可解释的放电和 ADHD 特征族、基础模型预训练、跨模态生成与解码以及隐私漏洞。各方法的侧重点不同：基准设计和参与者的保留验证、可解释性与可说明性、端侧效率，以及多模态或物理启发的表示学习。

themes.name: 多模态情感识别与社会理解
themes.summary: 这些论文构建多模态情感识别系统，融合面部、语音、生理和文本线索，处理输入可靠性、跨模态一致性与冲突、路由效率以及混合专家多样性。另一些将情感建模扩展到群体级社会动态、AI 孪生社会判断、教育情感轨迹和视听面部表情分析，架构各异，如分层融合、时间异构图和自适应模态级联。

themes.name: 因果推断与部署的统计护栏
themes.summary: 这些论文开发统计机制以使部署决策更具可辩护性：小规模 A/B 试验的功效分析、在少量校准图像下风险控制的模型更新采纳、用于歧视审计的跨上下文阈值检验，以及部署风险模型的随时有效监测。另一些工作贡献了针对观察性或外部控制数据的处理效应的目标学习和鲁棒森林估计器，以及一篇从第一性原理出发的评论，指出 AI 方法在局部成功但未能满足更广泛推断假设的地方，并提出了一个在治理不透明下用于 LLM 系统的 Zero-Trust 运维保障框架。

highlights.title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
highlights.authors: Jian Xu, Delu Zeng, Qibin Zhao
highlights.why: 这项细致的审计将近期文本到图像系统中真正的智能体增益与简单的拒绝重试区分开来，重新框架了所声称的改进，并提供了闭式预算和真正的智能体上限。
highlights.key_result: 审计四个近期系统并使用官方评估器，我们发现 SRR 在 GenEval 上的准确率与 OctoT2I 相当（0.962 对 0.96），根据验证器的不同恢复了 GEMS 增益的 63% 至 90%，并且以每张图像 2.3 次生成超过 GenPilot 12 个百分点；该效果在未针对基准调优的生成器以及 T2I-CompBench++ 上持续存在。我们还表明，OctoT2I 的路由所换来的是计算量（在同等准确率下比 SRR 约少 2.5），而非准确率，并且在 GenEval 2 上，即使由评估器从五个样本中选出的最佳样本，仍比 GEMS 报告的分数低 15 个百分点（其 95% 区间上端为 12）。
evidence: Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++.

We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5 less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy.

The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval).

highlights.title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
highlights.authors: Yiyang Zhu, Xin Li, Guangyuan Liu et al.
highlights.theme: Multimodal LLM Reasoning, Alignment, and Hallucination Verification
highlights.why: 构建了具有精确模拟无线电场和反事实的 RadioVISTA，揭示了前沿 VLM 能定位强场但无法追踪传播路径。
highlights.key_result: 在19个被评估的模型中，前两名在大约十例中有九例能识别出覆盖最好的城市区域。然而，当被问及是否存在单条直射或单墙反射路径时，它们的准确率分别下降到 76.5% 和 61.8%，而随机基线为 50%。
evidence: Across 19 evaluated models, the top two identify the best-covered urban region in roughly nine out of ten cases. Yet when asked whether a single direct or one-wall path exists, their accuracy drops to 76.5% and 61.8% against a 50% random baseline. We term this gap field--path dissociation, where models judge the whole without resolving its parts ( sec:eval,sec:readtrace).

highlights.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
highlights.authors: Mark Zhao, Pengcheng Wang, Rui Yang et al.
highlights.why: AutoPILOT 框架让视觉游戏智能体在模型调用之间运行宏和闭环控制器，实现相对于 VISTA 的大幅实时增益，并引入了 AFK-Bench。
highlights.key_result: 在相同预算下使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，AutoPILOT 的实时成功率达到 68.6%，而 VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上，它实时保持 80.0%，而 VISTA 从 84.1% 下降到 42.9%。其增益跨模型保持，并且它在达到 VISTA 最终成功率的 API 成本仅为其五分之一。
evidence: With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA , and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA 's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost.

highlights.title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
highlights.authors: Wenqi Marshall Guo, Kuan-Hao Huang, Junda Chen et al.
highlights.why: 一个使用每分钟 JSON 记录的最小化编码智能体框架在超长视频问答上击败了专门构建的记忆图，对复杂记忆设计提出了质疑。
highlights.key_result: 在四个超长视频基准上，使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 VideoJSON 在 EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench 和 MM-Lifelong Week 上分别比 MAGIC-Video 高出 7.0、20.0 和 24.75 分，并比之前最佳的 EgoMemReason 分数高出 12.6 分。在四个能力逐渐增强的策略模型上，VideoJSON 的平均分数相对于最弱模型最多提升 11.58 分，而 MAGIC-Video 最多为 5.50 分。
evidence: On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points.
Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video.

highlights.title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
highlights.authors: Kewei Lian, Jiayi Zhai, Anji Liu
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM Inference and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: 推导了注意力误差界，从而启发了查询自适应 KV 聚类，并实现了新的质量-延迟帕累托前沿，注意力加速最高达 7.6 倍。
highlights.key_result: 在两个模型和三个基准上的实验表明，RefineKV 保持了接近全注意力的质量，同时在注意力阶段实现了最高 7.6 的加速，解码速度提升 1.66 倍，建立了新的质量-延迟帕累托前沿。
evidence: Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6 speedup in the attention phase and 1.66 faster decoding, establishing a new quality–latency Pareto frontier.

highlights.title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
highlights.authors: Ulrik Unneberg, Shiyi Wang, Lee Cheuk-Kit et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion and Flow Matching Generative Models
highlights.why: 将无分类器引导和可扩展训练配方引入一步 Beckmann 传输模型，无需蒸馏即可达到很强的 ImageNet 一步 FID。
highlights.key_result: 在表示自编码器的潜在空间中从零训练，SBM 在 ImageNet 256x256 上达到一步 FID 1.6，无需教师模型或特征损失，并且比 Improved-MeanFlow 基线少 3.2 倍的 FLOPs。在文本到图像生成中，它以一次网络评估达到 GenEval 分数 0.86。
evidence: Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs.
In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation.

highlights.title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Gun Kaynar, Boshen Yan, Carl Kingsford
highlights.why: 引入了 RetryRealistic，一个受控故障注入测试平台，发现 6-26% 的静默编造，并确定部分数据故障是关键驱动因素，同时用验证优先的监视器减少编造。
highlights.key_result: 在 2,100 个故障运行上评估四个智能体并与真实情况对照，我们发现恢复不可靠（正确率 19--68%），且常常是静默的：6--26% 的运行以自信的编造结束，即把错误答案当作事实断言。我们表明编造可以减少：一个验证优先的 Monitor，将检查建立在结构化工具输出上并发布纠正指令而非硬性阻断，将正确恢复率从 45.6% 提高到 56.3%，并将编造从 17.3% 降低到 10.8%。
evidence: Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19--68% correct) and frequently silent: 6--26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact.

We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%.

highlights.title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM Inference and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: 将语法视为结构化输出推测解码中的第二个 drafter，无需新内核即可提升接受长度，并产生实际服务影响。
highlights.key_result: GaaD 将平均接受长度（每个验证步骤的 token 数，包括奖励 token）从 2.06 提高到 5.43（在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上对 MTP；在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上从 1.99 到 5.31），在 Qwen3-4B 上对 DFlash 从 1.57 到 4.13，对 n-gram 从 1.30 到 3.64，并且解码速度比每个 drafter 单独的最佳配置在批量大小 1 时快 2.66--2.81 倍，在批量大小 64 时快 1.14--1.70 倍。
evidence: GaaD raises the average acceptance length (tokens per verify step, including the bonus token) from 2.06 to 5.43 for MTP on Qwen3.5-0.8B (1.99 to 5.31 on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), from 1.57 to 4.13 for DFlash and from 1.30 to 3.64 for n-gram on Qwen3-4B, and decodes 2.66--2.81 faster than the best configuration of each drafter alone at batch size 1 and 1.14--1.70 faster at batch size 64.

news.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo

Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days

news.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification

news.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
news.summary: Google Research 提出了 DeepCrossAttention (DCA)，一种架构，用可学习的逐 token 路由权重和对前一层嵌入的深度可分离交叉注意力替换固定的加性残差连接，该工作发表在 ICML 2025 论文中。作者报告模型达到相同质量的速度最高快三倍，参数量减少最多 30-40%，参数增加可忽略不计。

news.title: Accelerating Direct Sparse Solvers for Computational Engineering with NVIDIA cuDSS 1.0
